title: On the Stability of Type II Blowup for the Keller-Segel System in High Dimensions
summary: We study finite-time blowup for the parabolic--elliptic Keller--Segel system on $\mathbb{R}^d$ in dimensions $d\geq11$, where the problem is mass supercritical. For every integer $l\geq2$, we construct smooth radially symmetric solutions whose radial mass variable concentrates the normalized stationary state $Q$ at a quantized scale. Each blowup regime can be realized by solutions with nonnegative population density throughout their classical lifespan.
